text:
pat: quick proposal to tighten postmortem follow-ups so action items don't stall. trying to make this as low-cost as possible.
noor: yes please. our last outage had good writeup but actions languished.
sam: +1 on low ceremony. what do you have in mind?
pat: sketch: combine a one-row "remediation card" + short cadence + explicit ownership rules. something teams can copy into any postmortem.
jess: sounds useful. a one-row makes it easy to paste into docs and sheets.
pat: proposed remediation card format:
```
ID: R-2026-001
Summary: brief sentence
Owner: single person (no team)
ETA: ISO date
Status: todo / in-progress / blocked / done
Blocker: short note or link
Next-check: ISO date (weekly until done)
Link: PR/issue/monitoring link
```
noor: require owner confirmation within 48h of postmortem publish. if no confirmation -> IC reassigns and pings. keeps things moving.
sam: what about cadence? weekly sounds fine but lightweight.
pat: cadence recommendation: short async updates weekly for 6 weeks, then triage monthly until closed. add two automated reminders (T+14, T+30) from incident-bot.
jess: i'll make a tiny copy/paste snippet and a Google sheet template with counts by status. will post link here.
incident-bot: Reminder scheduled: "remediation-confirm: R-2026-001" in 48 hours for @noor
noor: roles proposal: Incident Commander (rotates every 6w), Remediation Owner (per card), PM reviewer, SRE verifier. IC owns escalation if owner no-shows.
sam: i can take the next IC rotation slot and pilot the reassignment rule for 2 incidents.
pat: immediate tasks we can do this sprint:
- create copy/paste remediation snippet (jess) — due EOD tomorrow
- add remediation-card example to runbook (pat) — due Wed
- set up incident-bot reminder macros for T+14/T+30 (noor) — due Fri
- backfill current open postmortems with remediation cards and owners (sam) — due in 3 days
jess: got it. i'll keep the sheet minimal: one-row template + a dashboard widget with counts and a "stale >30d" flag.
sam: small enforcement idea: owners must post an ETA within 48h or the IC will reassign and mark as 'blocked by owner-no-confirm'. that makes slippage visible.
noor: agree. also log ownership transfers in the card row with timestamp. transparency reduces accidental drift.
pat: thought: run a 6-week pilot on the next two incidents and evaluate in the postmortem process retro. metrics: time-to-ETA, percent items closed by 30d, number of ownership transfers.
jess: will add a column for "owner_history" so transfers are clear.
incident-bot: Reminder scheduled: "remediation-check T+14: R-2026-001" in 14 days for @sam @jess
sam: ok let's lock it in. owners, please update your row before the weekly checks. low friction = better compliance.
noor: no objections. i'll PR the incident-bot templates and update the runbook snippet once pat's copy is in.
pat: thanks all. i'll file the runbook PR after jess posts the snippet and sam starts backfilling.
